framework.name: SOC 2 Type II
framework.description: SOC 2 Type II framework based on Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy.

requirements.name: Identifies and Develops Response to Incidents

controls.name: RBAC Enabled
controls.description: Role-Based Access Control is implemented and enforced across all systems.

controls.name: MFA Enforced
controls.description: Multi-Factor Authentication is required for all user accounts.

controls.name: Quarterly Access Reviews
controls.description: Access rights are reviewed quarterly to ensure least privilege.

controls.name: User Provisioning Approved
controls.description: User account creation requires manager approval.

controls.name: Background Checks
controls.description: Background checks are performed for all employees prior to system access.

controls.name: Timely Access Revocation
controls.description: Access is revoked within 24 hours of termination or role change.

controls.name: Offboarding Checklist
controls.description: Comprehensive offboarding checklist ensures all access is removed.

controls.name: Least Privilege
controls.description: Users are granted minimum necessary permissions.

controls.name: Data Classification
controls.description: Data is classified by sensitivity level.

controls.name: Encryption at Rest
controls.description: Sensitive data is encrypted when stored.

controls.name: Encryption in Transit
controls.description: Data is encrypted during transmission using TLS 1.2+.

controls.name: Password Policy
controls.description: Strong password requirements are enforced (12+ chars, complexity).

controls.name: Secrets Vault
controls.description: Secrets are stored in a centralized vault (e.g., secfn).

controls.name: Credential Rotation
controls.description: Credentials are rotated at least every 90 days.

controls.name: Security Monitoring
controls.description: Security events are monitored continuously.

controls.name: Intrusion Detection
controls.description: IDS/IPS systems detect and prevent intrusions.

controls.name: Log Aggregation
controls.description: Logs are aggregated centrally for analysis.

controls.name: Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Documented incident response plan is maintained and tested.

controls.name: Incident Response Team
controls.description: Dedicated incident response team is designated.

controls.name: Incident Postmortem
controls.description: Postmortems are conducted for all major incidents.

controls.name: Weekly Log Review
controls.description: Security logs are reviewed weekly by security team.

controls.name: Alert Triage
controls.description: Security alerts are triaged within 1 hour.

controls.name: Incident Communication
controls.description: Stakeholders are notified of incidents per communication plan.

controls.name: Incident Remediation
controls.description: Incidents are remediated according to severity SLAs.

controls.name: Incident Playbooks
controls.description: Runbooks exist for common incident scenarios.

controls.name: Incident Escalation
controls.description: Clear escalation paths are defined and followed.

controls.name: Incident Documentation
controls.description: All incidents are documented in ticketing system.

controls.name: Change Approval
controls.description: Production changes require approval from change board.

controls.name: Change Testing
controls.description: Changes are tested in non-production environment.

controls.name: Change Rollback Plan
controls.description: Rollback procedures exist for all production changes.

controls.name: Capacity Planning
controls.description: System capacity is reviewed quarterly and planned.

controls.name: Performance Monitoring
controls.description: System performance metrics are monitored continuously.

controls.name: SLA Monitoring
controls.description: Service Level Agreements are monitored and reported.

controls.name: Uptime Monitoring
controls.description: System uptime is monitored and alerted.

controls.name: Health Checks
controls.description: Automated health checks run on all services.

controls.name: Failover Testing
controls.description: Failover procedures are tested quarterly.

controls.name: Daily Backups
controls.description: Critical data is backed up daily.

controls.name: Quarterly Backup Testing
controls.description: Backup restoration is tested quarterly.

controls.name: Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.description: Documented disaster recovery plan is maintained and tested annually.

controls.name: Confidentiality Agreements
controls.description: All personnel sign confidentiality agreements.

controls.name: Secure Disposal
controls.description: Media and data are securely destroyed per policy.

controls.name: Data Retention Policy
controls.description: Data retention periods are defined and enforced.

controls.name: Data Deletion Verification
controls.description: Data deletion is verified and logged.
